column1: # Public function mutants of deflate, replayed against the exact proof of Goal.deflate
# (Zlib.Deflate.Universal.deflate_safety). Each edits the body of `deflate` in the translation only.
# The semantic mutants of the deflate proof, with paired edits in the proof restatements, are in
# deflate-header.tsv, deflate-strategies.tsv and deflate-ops.tsv. A one-file edit of the body
# is first rejected where the proof restates `deflate` as its phases (`deflate_phases`), so these rows show
# that the exact proof does not survive the edit; the semantic evidence is in the lists above. Each edit
# drops a test, so the kernel rejects the restatement quickly; an arithmetic or call change in the
# trailer was tried and made the kernel replay exceed its memory budget instead.
# NAME
deflate-accept-null-output
deflate-accept-negative-flush
column3: flush > Z_BLOCK || flush < 0 then return Z_STREAM_ERROR

column1: deflate-accept-null-input
# Public function mutants of deflateInit2_, replayed against the exact proof of Goal.deflateInit2_
# (ZlibF.Spec.Public.Proofs.DeflateInit2.deflateInit2_proof). The two range edits are killed in the
# universal proof (deflate.c.init.general). The dropped NULL check and the dropped cleanup are killed
# first at the restatement of deflateInit_ with default parameters (deflate.c.init.default); the
# exact kernel replay of deflateInit2_proof rejects all four.
deflateInit2-memlevel-zero
column3: if memLevel < 1 || memLevel > MAX_MEM_LEVEL || method != Z_DEFLATED ||
column4: if memLevel < 0 || memLevel > MAX_MEM_LEVEL || method != Z_DEFLATED ||

column1: deflateInit2-window-seven
deflateInit2-state-null-unchecked
column3: let s ← allocDeflateState\n  if s == none then return Z_MEM_ERROR\n

column1: deflateInit2-failure-not-freed
column3: let _ ← deflateEnd strm\n    return Z_MEM_ERROR\n  -- s->sym_buf
